column1: # Columns (tab-separated): file, enclosing routine, called routine, actual
# argument (an element of a pointer or assumed-shape array; blanks and case
# are ignored). Built with tools/conformance-harvest.R from gfortran 16
# logs of MUMPS 5.9.1 and reviewed. A build with -fcheck=pointer,array-temps
# reports no array temporary while the package tests run, i.e. there the
# sections pass the same address as the elements did.
# Found by LLVM flang 21, which rejects these: the callees are the C
# routines, MPI stubs and type-agnostic kernels given explicit interfaces by
# patches 0003-0005, whose NO_ARG_CHECK dummies make gfortran accept the
# element. Harvested from make -k flang logs (rounds until clean). The row
# blocks LRB%R(K_CUMUL,1) and R_WORKSPACE(K_CUMUL,1) of DMUMPS_DECONVERT_LRB*
# have no contiguous section; patch 0010 passes views instead.
